text.a01: [excited] Hi everyone, sorry to keep you waiting~!
text.a03: [curious] Did you really come to see me?
text.a04: [giggles] Ehehe, I'm so happy! Today is a special fan meeting, just for you.
text.a05: [cheerful] First, a handshake! Hold out your hand?
text.a06: [surprised] Oh, your hands are cold…! Was it cold outside?
text.a07: [softly] Then… shall we talk up close, just for a bit?
text.a09: [whispers] Actually, I was super nervous today.
text.a11: [whispers] But when I saw your face, I forgot all about it.
text.a13: [playful] Hey, close your eyes. Guess which side I'm talking from.
text.a20: [sighs softly] Phew… the stage lights made me a bit warm.
text.a21: [curious] Your cheeks are red too! An ice-cold drink, or the fan — which one?
text.d3: [whispers] Keep holding it there. …This ear's warm, right?
text.f3: [whispers] The breeze comes from that side. …This ear's warm, right?
text.a23: [excited] Oh, I know! Let's take a picture together?
text.a25: [giggles] Ehehe, great face! I'll treasure this picture.
text.a26: [warmly] And… this is for you. My straw hat.
text.a27: [giggles] Let me put it on you. …Yep, it suits you!
text.a28: [softly] One last thing… will you call my name?
